title: DevExp Standup 2026-03-25
content:
Date: 2026-03-25
Attendees: Samira, Connor, Aisha, Diego, Maya (product), Jeremy (support)
Notes-tl;dr: final RC for JS + Python SDKs this week; docs quickstart revamp progressing, need final reviews on sample app PRs; CI flake on macOS runner still blocking release tagging.

Yesterday
- SDK: cut internal RC (v1.8.0-rc.1) for JS + Python. Basic streaming + function-calling tests green locally. Connor pushed fixes to streaming framing bug (GH #412).
- Docs: Aisha finished draft of new quickstart flow (landing -> run locally -> deploy using Redwood Hosted). Posted Confluence draft and linked examples.
- Samples: Diego opened two PRs: quickstart-chat-app and quickstart-embed-search. Both mostly done, but embed-search needs an env var cleanup and READMEs.
- CI/Release: Jenkins macOS runner flakes on publish step (keychain unlock). Reproduced 2/5 runs.

Today
- Ship RC to wider beta users pending CI stabilization. Priority: unblock macOS runner OR add fallback publish from Linux. Connor to try ephemeral GPG publish tonight.
- Docs review: ask PM and support to sanity-check wording for security/compliance section (private deployments notes). Aisha will ping Maya + Jeremy by EOD.
- Samples: Diego to address README TODOs and smaller lint fixes; request reviewers from Solutions Eng (Diego to add reviewers).
- Quickstarts: target cut of quickstarts bundle for marketing by Fri 2026-03-27. Need 1-2 small screenshots and script for the demo. Samira to coordinate with Design for screenshots.

Blockers / Risks
- CI macOS flake blocking formal RC publish (high). Mitigation: fall back to Linux publish and post a follow-up tag once mac runner stable. Connor owns.
- Doc review bandwidth: PMs busy this week; risk of missing marketing cut. Aisha to escalate in product weekly meeting.
- Sample app credentials: embed-search uses a test API key that is currently in CI secrets only. Need to add instructions to rotate keys and use REDWOOD_TEST_KEY. Diego to add note and env-var template.

Decisions / Calls
- Release tagging: proceed with RC publish from Linux if macOS still flaky by 18:00 PT. Post an internal note about the workaround. (Owner: Samira)
- Quickstart format: standardize on two formats — 1) local dev (docker-less) and 2) deploy-to-hosted (one-click deploy instructions). Keep both in the quickstarts repo root. (Owner: Aisha)

Action items
- Connor: try GPG ephemeral publish on mac runner + open issue to track keychain flake (JIRA-DEVEXP-358). Target: tonight (2026-03-25).
- Aisha: Ping PM + Support for doc review, update Confluence quickstart draft with final headings. Target: 2026-03-26.
- Diego: finish README updates, add env var template, request reviewers for PRs. Target: 2026-03-26.
- Samira: Coordinate screenshots with Design and draft email for beta testers about RC changes and known macOS publish workaround. Target: 2026-03-26 morning.

Follow-ups / Notes to self
- Add a small section in quickstarts about "production cost considerations" (batching, token limits, model variants). Might pull content from Optimize team notes.
- Check previous standup 2026-03-18 for unresolved TODOs (embedding CI fixes).
- We should surface per-route cost examples in the docs console screenshots — ask Console team for a sample export.

Quick links (work in progress)
- SDK RC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412
- Samples repo quickstarts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/tree/main/quickstarts
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-DEVEXP-quickstarts
- JIRA: JIRA-DEVEXP-358 (CI macOS flake)

Misc / Brainstorm (informal)
- Could we add a "Try in playground" button in quickstarts that spins up a sandbox token (short-lived)? Pros: lower friction. Cons: security + cost. Worth prototyping.
- Consider bundling a tiny express/fastapi example that shows streaming + function-calls together (demo script + prerecorded video).

Next standup: 2026-04-01 09:30 PT
